tldr: Mars through the 11th house brings focus to friends, networks, community, hopes, and collective work.
body: Mars transiting the 11th house energizes friends, networks, community, hopes, and collective work. For about six weeks, drive, heat, conflict, desire, and action move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is an activation transit: it brings momentum and courage, but also heat that needs a clear outlet.
business: Mars supports community contribution and future goals: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Impulsiveness, conflict, burnout, or belonging without discernment.
advice: Aim the fire in the 11th house deliberately. Work with friends, networks, community, hopes, and collective work without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
